summary: install/list/trust/update/remove plugin packs (untrusted until you trust them)
usage: ops plugin add <owner/repo|path>[@tag] --yes | list | trust <name> --yes | update <name> --yes | remove <name> --yes
hints: Installs a pack under plugins/<name>/, but its verbs are capped at confirm until `ops plugin trust <name> --yes` — self-declared risk never takes effect at install. add/update/remove/trust need --yes; list is read-only. Common mistake: expecting a freshly added pack to run at its declared risk.
